name: spell-server
description: Serving pages locally (server) and assembling them (assembler):  Spell's generic page-server library

scripts.ts: yarn workspaces foreach -W --exclude spell-server -pv -j 4 run ts
scripts.test: yarn workspaces foreach -W --exclude spell-server -pv -j 4 run test
scripts.lint: yarn workspaces foreach -W --exclude spell-server -pv -j 4 run lint
scripts.format: yarn workspaces foreach -W --exclude spell-server -pv -j 4 run format
scripts.review: yarn workspaces foreach -W --exclude spell-server -v run review
